items.title: 接班風險遽升！華爾街示警：黃仁勳若被迫離職 輝達股價恐暴跌至少20%
items.title_en: Succession Risk Soars! Wall Street Warns Nvidia Stock Could Plunge at Least 20% If Jensen Huang Is Forced Out
paras: AI晶片巨擘輝達創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳因一連串個人醜聞身陷風暴，美媒報導稱該公司董事會正考慮將其罷免，市場擔憂輝達恐面臨領導層真空，華爾街分析師更警告若黃仁勳突然離職，輝達股價可能重挫20%甚至更多。
事件源於黃仁勳被曝婚外情，《紐約時報》周三(11日)更報導稱其與一名直接向其匯報的高管存在特殊關係，《華爾街日報》隨後披露輝達董事會正準備罷免黃仁勳，並考慮任命財務長克雷斯為臨時執行長，同時對外尋找新任人選。受此影響，連日下跌的輝達在周三盤後交易一度再跌近10%。
華爾街對輝達的熱情迅速降溫。美國投行Baird將其評等從「買進」下調至「中立」，目標價從500美元狂砍至200美元，降幅超過60%，摩根士丹利也將其從「首選股」名單中移除。
此外，瑞穗證券、花旗與富國銀行相繼下調目標價，其中瑞穗降至250美元，但部分機構仍維持「買進」評級，視當前股價為買入機會。
接受《CNBC》訪問的分析師普遍憂心領導層變天帶來的衝擊。Deepwater資產管理合夥人Gene Munster指出，對一家由創辦人主導且無明確二號人物的公司，離職傳聞是股價回調20%的前兆。
海港研究夥伴分析師Jay Goldberg也預期至少跌20%，並稱考慮到黃仁勳在公司管理體系的核心地位，實際跌幅可能更大。黃仁勳是輝達成立以來唯一一任執行長，目前有70名員工直接向其匯報，這種高度集權架構放大接班不確定性，市場擔憂的不僅是誰來接任，還包括決策機制能否平穩過渡。
不過，一些分析師認為長期影響可控。StoneX分析師Cody Acree與D.A. Davidson分析師Gil Luria強調，只要接班安排妥當，輝達長期經營未必受實質影響，因黃仁勳已奠定穩固的業務基礎與產業合作關係，未來兩年業務未必發生實質變化。
Wedbush分析師Matt Bryson則比較輝達與台積電的估值，認為兩者差距很大程度反映出市場對黃仁勳去留的擔憂。
對輝達而言，當前最大考驗是如何在應對醜聞與董事會決策的同時，向市場證明公司運作不依賴單一人。即將公布的業績以及管理層對公司治理的回應，將成為投資人判斷局勢走向的重要依據。
paras_en: Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the giant of AI chips, has been caught in a storm of personal scandals. U.S. media reports say the board is considering removing him, and the market fears a leadership vacuum at Nvidia. Wall Street analysts warn that if Huang were to leave suddenly, Nvidia’s share price could tumble 20% or more.

The trouble began when Huang was exposed for an extramarital affair. The New York Times reported on Wednesday the 11th that he has a special relationship with a senior executive who reports directly to him. The Wall Street Journal later disclosed that Nvidia’s board is preparing to oust Huang and is considering appointing CFO Chris (Cris) as interim CEO while searching externally for a permanent replacement. The news sent Nvidia, already sliding, down nearly another 10% in after‑hours trading on Wednesday.

Wall Street’s enthusiasm for Nvidia cooled quickly. U.S. investment bank Baird cut its rating from “Buy” to “Neutral” and slashed the target price from $500 to $200, a drop of more than 60%. Morgan Stanley also removed Nvidia from its “Top Picks” list.

In addition, Mizuho Securities, Citi and Wells Fargo all lowered their target prices, with Mizuho cutting its target to $250, though some firms kept a “Buy” rating, viewing the current price as a buying opportunity.

Analysts interviewed by CNBC expressed broad concern about the impact of a leadership shake‑up. Gene Munster, a partner at Deepwater Asset Management, said that for a founder‑led company with no clear second‑in‑command, rumors of a departure are a precursor to a 20% stock correction.

Jay Goldberg of Harbour Research Partners also expects at least a 20% drop, noting that given Huang’s central role in Nvidia’s management structure the actual decline could be larger. Huang has been the sole CEO since Nvidia’s founding and 70 employees report directly to him; this highly centralized structure magnifies succession uncertainty, and the market worries not only about who will replace him but also whether decision‑making can transition smoothly.

However, some analysts see the long‑term impact as manageable. StoneX analyst Cody Acree and D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria stressed that if the succession plan is handled properly, Nvidia’s long‑term operations may not be materially affected, as Huang has already built a solid business foundation and industry partnerships, and the business may not change substantially over the next two years.
Wedbush analyst Matt Bryson compared Nvidia’s valuation with TSMC’s, arguing that the large gap largely reflects market anxiety over Huang’s future at the company.

For Nvidia, the biggest test now is to navigate the scandal and board decisions while proving to the market that the company does not depend on a single individual. Upcoming earnings and management’s response to corporate‑governance issues will be key cues for investors assessing the direction of the situation.

items.title: 才說要停產、5天後又改口 馬斯克宣布Cybertruck延後退場
items.title_en: Elon Musk Announces Cybertruck Production Delay to Summer 2027
paras: 曾被特斯拉(TSLA-US)  執行長馬斯譽為「史上最好產品」的電動皮卡Cybertruck，停產時間再生變數。馬斯克週三（11 日）宣布，將延長生產至2027年夏末，以消化大量積壓訂單。
馬斯克上週五才表示，特斯拉計劃在2027年年中左右停止生產Cybertruck，將更多產能轉向無方向盤的自動駕駛計程車Cybercab。如今雖然停產時間略為延後，但Cybertruck即將退出市場的方向並未改變。
這項決定也意味著，曾被寄予厚望、肩負特斯拉進軍高利潤皮卡市場重任的Cybertruck，最終仍將面臨停產命運。
針對外界質疑Cybertruck無法獲利，馬斯克澄清，相關報導並不屬實，強調Cybertruck目前仍能實現獲利。
不過，他也坦言，Cybertruck的製造過程過於「複雜」，因此特斯拉不得不決定停產。
馬斯克同時透露，Cybertruck的訂單成長速度遠遠超過生產速度。按照原先規劃，特斯拉將在大約八個月後關閉生產線，屆時可能必須向大量客戶退還訂金。
如今馬斯克宣布延長生產至2027年夏末，主要就是為了進一步消化尚未交付的訂單。
Cybertruck於2019年底首次以概念車亮相，憑藉突破傳統的外觀設計迅速引發市場關注，評價也呈現兩極化。
相較於其他汽車製造商偏向保守、逐步改良的皮卡設計，Cybertruck採用稜角分明的車身線條與不鏽鋼材質，徹底打破傳統皮卡的外觀框架。
其設計據稱受到電影《回到未來》（Back to the Future）中經典車款DeLorean DMC-12啟發，特斯拉的宣傳影像更刻意營造出Cybertruck彷彿能在其他星球行駛的未來感，呼應馬斯克的太空探索野心。
Cybertruck亮相後一度掀起預訂熱潮。特斯拉表示，自2019年發表以來，累計收到超過100萬份預訂，每份訂金為100美元。
馬斯克當時更預估，Cybertruck每年銷量可達15萬至25萬輛，展現對這款電動皮卡的高度期待。
然而，Cybertruck最終未能實現當初設定的銷售目標。
根據汽車市場研究機構Cox Automotive統計，過去三年特斯拉僅售出約7.6萬輛Cybertruck，與馬斯克原先預估的年銷量相去甚遠。
值得注意的是，這項銷售數據還包括2025年特斯拉向馬斯克旗下另一家公司SpaceX出售、總價值達1.31億美元的Cybertruck。
Cybertruck的銷售困境也反映出美國電動皮卡市場面臨的挑戰。儘管這款車曾憑藉前衛設計與技術受到高度矚目，實際市場需求卻未能達到預期。
隨著特斯拉逐步將產能轉向Cybercab，Cybertruck這款曾被馬斯克稱為公司「有史以來最好產品」的電動皮卡，也將在2027年夏末迎來生產終點。
paras_en: The electric pickup truck Cybertruck, once hailed by Tesla CEO Elon Musk as the "best product in history," has its production halt date once again becoming uncertain. Musk announced on Wednesday (November 11) that production will be extended until the end of summer 2027 to absorb a large backlog of orders.

Last Friday, Musk had said Tesla plans to stop producing the Cybertruck around mid-2027, shifting more capacity to the steering‑less autonomous ride‑share vehicle Cybercab. Although the end date has been pushed back slightly, the direction of the Cybertruck’s exit from the market remains unchanged.
This decision also means that the Cybertruck, which had been expected to carry Tesla into the high‑margin pickup market, will ultimately face a production shutdown.
In response to external doubts that the Cybertruck could not be profitable, Musk clarified that such reports were untrue, emphasizing that the Cybertruck is still capable of generating profit.
However, he also admitted that the manufacturing process for the Cybertruck is too "complex," which is why Tesla had to decide to discontinue it.

Musk also revealed that the growth rate of Cybertruck orders far outpaces production speed. According to the original plan, Tesla would shut down the production line in about eight months, at which point it might have to refund deposits to a large number of customers.
Now that Musk has announced an extension of production until the end of summer 2027, the main reason is to further absorb the orders that have not yet been delivered.
The Cybertruck first appeared as a concept car at the end of 2019, quickly attracting market attention with its unconventional design, and its reception has been polarized.

Unlike other automakers that favor conservative, incremental pickup designs, the Cybertruck uses sharp, angular body lines and stainless steel, completely breaking the traditional pickup aesthetic framework.

Its design is said to be inspired by the classic DeLorean DMC‑12 from the film "Back to the Future," and Tesla’s promotional imagery deliberately creates a sense that the Cybertruck could drive on other planets, echoing Musk’s space‑exploration ambitions.
After its debut, the Cybertruck sparked a surge in pre‑orders. Tesla stated that since its 2019 launch, it has received over one million pre‑orders, each with a $100 deposit.
At the time, Musk estimated that the Cybertruck could sell 150,000 to 250,000 units per year, showing high expectations for the electric pickup.
However, the Cybertruck ultimately failed to meet the initially set sales targets.
According to automotive market research firm Cox Automotive, Tesla sold only about 76,000 Cybertrucks in the past three years, far below Musk’s original annual sales estimate.
Notably, this sales figure also includes the Cybertrucks sold in 2025 to Musk’s other company SpaceX for a total value of $131 million.

The Cybertruck’s sales difficulties also reflect the challenges facing the U.S. electric pickup market. Despite the vehicle’s avant‑garde design and technology drawing high attention, actual market demand fell short of expectations.
As Tesla gradually shifts capacity to the Cybercab, the Cybertruck—once called by Musk the company’s "best product ever"—will reach the end of its production run by the end of summer 2027.

items.title: 黃仁勳再爆與副總裁有染！隨扈扣留目擊者 要求簽保密協議
items.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Accused of Affair with Vice President, Security Detail Detains Witnesses, Demands NDA
paras: 在人工智慧晶片大廠輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳外遇而受到全球圍觀之際，《紐約時報》周三（11日）踢爆黃仁勳還曾與一名向他直接報告的高階主管發生婚外情。
《紐約時報》引述多名曾在輝達任職、但未具名人士報導，黃仁勳曾與輝達醫療事業副總裁Kimberly Powell發展關係。今年3月，在輝達一場大型會議期間，黃仁勳被拍到與Powell在加州聖荷西一家飯店內親密互動的畫面。
事發後，黃仁勳的隨扈扣留了目擊者，並要求對方簽署保密協議。
《紐約時報》指出，記者周三致電黃仁勳詢問他與Powell女士的關係時，黃仁勳表示，「我認為你不應該直接和我談這件事。」隨後便掛斷電話。
消息人士透露，黃仁勳和Powell的關係已在輝達內部受到議論。
輝達現行《商業行為準則》規定，員工必須避免使自身行為造成利益衝突，其中特別提及了「個人關係」，並承諾將對任何不當行為指控迅速展開調查。
在現代企業治理體系中，管理層與直屬下屬發生戀愛關係通常被視為重大合規漏洞，極易引發利益衝突與濫用職權的道德風險。
Powell於2008年加入輝達，負責將輝達晶片技術應用於高等教育和醫療保健領域的項目，尤其是在醫學影像設備方面。
她在輝達一路晉升，她的LinkedIn個人資料顯示，她於2016年晉升為人工智慧業務開發資深總監2017年底被任命為醫療保健副總裁，經常出席世界各地技術會議，代表輝達發表演說。
paras_en: While Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang is under global scrutiny for an alleged affair, the New York Times on Wednesday (11th) revealed that he also had an extramarital relationship with a senior executive who reported directly to him.

The Times cited unnamed former Nvidia employees, stating that Huang had a relationship with Nvidia Medical Business Vice President Kimberly Powell. In March, during a large Nvidia conference, Huang was photographed engaging in intimate interactions with Powell at a hotel in San Jose, California.
After the incident, Huang’s security detail detained the witness and demanded that the individual sign a confidentiality agreement.
When a reporter called Huang on Wednesday to inquire about his relationship with Ms. Powell, Huang replied, “I don’t think you should talk to me directly about this,” and then hung up the phone.
Sources say that the relationship between Huang and Powell has already become a topic of discussion within Nvidia’s internal circles.

Nvidia’s current Code of Business Conduct requires employees to avoid actions that create conflicts of interest, specifically mentioning “personal relationships,” and promises to launch a swift investigation into any allegations of misconduct.

In modern corporate governance, romantic relationships between management and direct subordinates are typically viewed as major compliance breaches, easily leading to conflicts of interest and ethical risks of abuse of power.
Powell joined Nvidia in 2008, responsible for applying Nvidia chip technology to higher education and healthcare projects, especially in medical imaging equipment.

Her LinkedIn profile shows a steady rise at Nvidia: promoted to Senior Director of AI Business Development in 2016, appointed Vice President of Healthcare at the end of 2017, and frequently attending global tech conferences to speak on behalf of Nvidia.

items.title: Anthropic上市前永續合約單日漲8% 交易者估值推升至1.84兆美元
items.title_en: Anthropic's Pre-IPO Futures Contract Rises 8% in a Day, Boosting Trader Valuation to $1.84 Trillion
paras: Anthropic上市前永續合約周三(11日)上漲8%，反映交易者對這家Claude模型開發商上市的需求升溫，加上AI類股反彈，帶動市場隱含估值升至約1.84兆美元。
該合約在Polymarket以ANT為代號，追蹤Anthropic的完全稀釋估值；周三下午報1,836.10點，24小時漲8%，盤中介於1,685.40至1,868.10點。其參考價格來自Hyperliquid上的Entropy io:ANTH市場，每點代表10億美元完全稀釋估值。該市場未平倉部位約2億美元。
另一個由trade.xyz提供、以每股價格計算的合約約報105美元，較Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)價格區間上限高約34%。永續合約反映交易者預期，並不代表Anthropic實際股權估值或上市價格。
Anthropic周二啟動上市路演，提出每股70至78美元的價格區間，計畫發行8.25億股；若以區間上限計算，募資約644億美元，完全稀釋估值約1.4兆美元。永續合約隱含估值比此上限高約31%。
彭博周三引述知情人士報導，IPO認購需求已達發售股數的數倍；《金融時報》則報導，承銷銀行正考慮將估值提高至1.5兆美元或以上。此前9月流出的早期上市文件草案，據報曾以約2兆美元估值為目標；近期AI類股大幅回檔後，Anthropic提出較低價格區間。
AI類股周三同步反彈。CoreWeave(CRWV-US)公布第三季財報後大漲約27%，輝達(NVDA-US)上漲5%，追蹤那斯達克100指數的Invesco QQQ信託(QQQ-US)上漲3.1%；Anthropic推出新辦公室工具後，微軟(MSFT-US)下跌2.1%。
Anthropic周二在舊金山活動中推出Claude Sheets試算表工具，以及Claude Meetings與Claude Whiteboards，擴大Claude在辦公室生產力軟體市場的應用。
分析師普遍肯定Anthropic採取較低的IPO價格區間。Wedbush分析師丹・艾夫斯周二在投資人報告中表示，這種規模的上市只有一次亮相機會，讓價格更容易被市場消化，比再多追求一輪估值更重要。
艾夫斯也指出，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、輝達、微軟、博通(AVGO-US)及另外三家夥伴提供的260億美元私募資金，可能比IPO headline估值更具意義。Trade Nation資深市場分析師大衛・莫里森也認為，面對科技股市場不確定性，Anthropic願意接受較低價格而非延後上市，是正面訊號。
Morningstar分析師馬利克・艾哈邁德・汗估算，Anthropic基本情境股權價值約1.7兆美元，樂觀情境略高於3兆美元，悲觀情境則為5,000億美元；他預期公司未來五年營收年均成長47%。他指出，財富500強企業每支出1,000美元，目前僅約1美元流向Anthropic。
不過，也有分析師質疑公司成本結構。22V Research創辦人丹尼斯・德布斯謝表示，Anthropic的S-1文件顯示，研發支出遠高於提供客戶服務的成本，而競爭對手可能決定市場價格。他警告，若情況如此，Anthropic可能逐漸成為差異化不足的「商品化智慧服務商」。他認為，投資人需要觀察公司上市後數季的正式數據，才能判斷長期合理利潤率。
Polymarket預測市場交易者給予Anthropic在11月19日開始交易的機率為86%，並認為股價首日收盤高於IPO發行價的機率為88%；但市場給予其首日市值高於1.5兆美元的機率只有43%。
paras_en: Anthropic's pre‑IPO perpetual contract rose 8% on Wednesday (the 11th), reflecting traders’ growing demand for the Claude model developer’s listing, and the AI‑stock rebound lifted the market’s implied valuation to about $1.84 trillion.

The contract trades on Polymarket under the ticker ANT and tracks Anthropic’s fully diluted valuation; on Wednesday afternoon it was quoted at 1,836.10 points, up 8% over 24 hours, trading between 1,685.40 and 1,868.10 points during the day. Its reference price comes from the Entropy io:ANTH market on Hyperliquid, where each point represents a $100 million fully diluted valuation. The market has roughly $200 million in open interest.

Another contract, provided by trade.xyz and priced per share, was quoted at about $105, roughly 34% above the upper end of Anthropic’s IPO price range. The perpetual contract reflects traders’ expectations and does not represent Anthropic’s actual equity valuation or listing price.

Anthropic kicked off its roadshow on Tuesday, proposing a $70 to $78 per‑share price range and planning to issue 825 million shares; at the upper end of the range, the proceeds would be about $64.4 billion, implying a fully diluted valuation of roughly $1.4 trillion. The perpetual contract’s implied valuation is about 31% higher than this upper limit.

Bloomberg quoted an insider on Wednesday saying that IPO subscription demand had reached multiple times the number of shares offered; the Financial Times reported that underwriters were considering raising the valuation to $1.5 trillion or more. Earlier September, the early filing draft had targeted a valuation of about $2 trillion; after a sharp pullback in AI stocks, Anthropic proposed a lower price range.

AI stocks rebounded on Wednesday as well. CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) surged about 27% after its Q3 earnings, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) rose 5%, and the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ‑US), which tracks the Nasdaq‑100, climbed 3.1%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) fell 2.1% after Anthropic launched new office tools.

On Tuesday in San Francisco, Anthropic unveiled Claude Sheets, a spreadsheet tool, as well as Claude Meetings and Claude Whiteboards, expanding Claude’s presence in the office productivity software market.

Analysts broadly praised Anthropic’s decision to set a lower IPO price range. Wedbush analyst Dan Aves said on Tuesday in an investor briefing that a company of this size only has one chance to debut, so a lower price is easier for the market to digest than chasing another valuation round.

Aves also noted that the $26 billion private‑funding round from Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Nvidia, Microsoft, Broadcom (AVGO‑US), and three other partners may be more meaningful than the headline IPO valuation. Trade Nation senior market analyst David Morrison said that, amid uncertainty in the tech‑stock market, Anthropic’s willingness to accept a lower price rather than delay the listing is a positive signal.

Morningstar analyst Malik Ahmad Khan estimated that Anthropic’s base‑case equity value is about $1.7 trillion, a bullish scenario slightly above $3 trillion, and a bearish scenario at $500 billion; he expects the company’s revenue to grow at an annualized 47% over the next five years. He pointed out that for every $1,000 spent by Fortune 500 companies, only about $1 currently goes to Anthropic.

However, some analysts questioned the company’s cost structure. Dennis Debus, founder of 22V Research, said that Anthropic’s S‑1 filings show R&D spending far exceeding customer‑service costs, and competitors may set market prices. He warned that if this is the case, Anthropic could gradually become a commoditized “intelligent‑services” provider lacking differentiation. He believes investors should watch the company’s formal data for several quarters after the listing to judge long‑term profitability.

Polymarket predicts that traders give Anthropic an 86% probability of trading starting on November 19, and an 88% probability that the first‑day close will be above the IPO price; however, the market assigns only a 43% probability that the first‑day market cap will exceed $1.5 trillion.

items.title: 網友拱延攬黃仁勳 馬斯克：那是我的榮幸
items.title_en: Netizens Urge Elon Musk to Recruit Jensen Huang; Musk: "It Would Be My Honor"
paras: 人工智慧晶片大廠輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳面臨下台危機，有網友呼籲全球首富馬斯克延攬黃仁勳，馬斯克回應：「那是我的榮幸。」
在黃仁勳桃色風暴爆出之際，馬斯克也曾為黃仁勳辯護，稱黃仁勳在人工智慧領域的地位無可取代。
據《彭博》周四 （12日）報導，輝達正與外部機構合作，物色可能接替執行長黃仁勳的人選，包括考慮任命一位過渡時期執行長。另據《華爾街日報》報導，輝達董事會最快可能周三開會討論黃仁勳去留。
華爾街正密切評估，如果這位人工智慧基礎設施核心架構師被迫離職，將對整個行業的資金鏈、客戶信心與發展前景造成何種程度的衝擊。
雪上加霜的是，《紐約時報》周三引述多名曾在輝達任職、但未具名人士報導，黃仁勳曾與輝達醫療事業副總裁Kimberly Powell發展關係。今年3月，在輝達一場大型會議期間，黃仁勳被拍到與Powell在加州聖荷西一家飯店內親密互動的畫面。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence chip giant Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang faces a crisis of removal; netizens called on the world’s richest man Elon Musk to recruit Huang, and Musk responded: “It would be my honor.”
Amid the scandal surrounding Huang’s alleged affair, Musk also defended Huang, saying his position in the AI field is irreplaceable.

According to Bloomberg on Thursday (the 12th), Nvidia is working with external firms to identify possible successors to CEO Jensen Huang, including considering appointing an interim CEO. The Wall Street Journal also reported that Nvidia’s board could meet as early as Wednesday to discuss Huang’s future.
Wall Street is closely assessing how the forced departure of this core AI infrastructure architect would impact the industry’s financing chain, customer confidence, and development outlook.

Adding insult to injury, the New York Times on Wednesday quoted multiple unnamed former Nvidia employees who reported that Huang had a relationship with Nvidia’s vice president of medical affairs Kimberly Powell. In March this year, during a large Nvidia conference, Huang was photographed having an intimate interaction with Powell at a hotel in San Jose, California.

items.title: 沒買輝達也受影響！標普500權重近8% 一份財報牽動全美退休金
items.title_en: Even Without Buying Nvidia, Investors Are Affected! S&P 500 Weight Near 8% and a Single Report Moves All American Pension Funds
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 即將於 11 月 17 日公布財報，將吸引數百萬名投資人關注，即使他們並未直接持有輝達股票。由於輝達在標普 500 指數中的權重接近 8%，其財報表現可能牽動全美退休投資組合，也凸顯許多被動投資人可能未曾察覺的持股集中風險。
Siebert Financial 投資長馬萊克 (Mark Malek) 表示：「輝達公布財報的日子，就是你的 401(k) 退休金帳戶公布成績的日子。」
輝達的影響力早已超越直接持有該公司股票的股東。即使投資人只是透過追蹤標普 500 指數的退休基金進行投資，也可能受到輝達個別事件的影響。
標普 500 指數採市值加權編製，市值愈大的企業，所占權重就愈高，因此股價波動對指數表現的影響也愈大。
根據道富環球投資管理 (State Street) 資料，截至 10 月 28 日，輝達占 SPDR 標普 500 ETF (SPY-US) 投資組合的 7.81%，高於蘋果 (AAPL-US) 的 7.52% 及微軟 (MSFT-US) 的 5.91%。前十大持股合計占基金資產約 38%。
即使投資人同時持有多檔 ETF，也不代表能有效分散集中風險，因為追蹤美國大型股的基金，往往持有許多相同的超大型企業。
11 月 17 日財報為何如此重要
假設輝達的指數權重維持不變且其他成分股價格持平，輝達股價每波動 10%，就會為標普 500 指數的報酬率帶來約 0.78 個百分點的增減；當然，指數的實際漲跌幅仍需視整體市場表現而定。
輝達預定於美東時間 11 月 17 日下午 5 點舉行法說會，並於會前公布 2027 會計年度第三季財報，屆時市場焦點將鎖定在 AI 運算需求是否延續，以及資料中心資本支出的成長動能。
此外，這份財報發布之際，公司內部正籠罩著特有的不確定性。輝達董事表示，在有報導指出執行長黃仁勳成為外國情報行動鎖定的目標後，董事會已啟動獨立調查。
不過董事會強調，目前並無跡象顯示國家安全或輝達的商業機密遭到外洩，相關指控仍在審查階段，尚未成為定論。
投資人該注意什麼
馬萊克將投資風險區分為兩類，一類是影響整體股市的市場風險，另一類則是個別公司的特定風險，後者通常可以透過分散持股來降低。
他擔憂的是，當指數權重過度集中在少數企業時，單一公司的問題就可能對原本以為已充分分散風險的投資人造成更大衝擊。
在超大型科技股領漲期間，市值加權指數確實為投資人帶來可觀報酬，但採取等權重配置的基金也有各自的取捨。
重點並不是要求投資人放棄指數基金，而是必須清楚了解自己實際持有哪些資產。
隨著財報日逼近，投資人或許應重新檢視自己的 401(k) 退休金帳戶、標普 500 指數基金，以及其他科技或成長型 ETF，確認其中有多少資金實際曝險於輝達。
即使沒有直接買進輝達股票，投資人的退休儲蓄仍可能隨著這份財報的表現而波動。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) is set to release its earnings on November 17, drawing the attention of millions of investors, even those who do not directly own Nvidia shares. With Nvidia’s weight in the S&P 500 close to 8%, its earnings performance could sway the entire U.S. retirement portfolio and highlight the concentration risk that many passive investors may not have realized.
Mark Malek, CIO of Siebert Financial, said: “The day Nvidia releases its earnings is the day your 401(k) retirement account reports its performance.”
Nvidia’s influence extends beyond shareholders who own the stock directly. Even investors who invest through retirement funds tracking the S&P 500 may be affected by Nvidia’s individual events.
The S&P 500 is a market‑capitalization‑weighted index, so the larger a company’s market value, the higher its weight, and price swings have a greater impact on the index’s performance.

According to State Street Global Investors, as of October 28, Nvidia accounted for 7.81% of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY-US) portfolio, higher than Apple (AAPL-US) at 7.52% and Microsoft (MSFT-US) at 5.91%. The top ten holdings together represent about 38% of the fund’s assets.
Even if investors hold multiple ETFs, it does not guarantee effective diversification of concentration risk, because funds tracking large U.S. stocks often hold many of the same mega‑cap companies.
Why the November 17 earnings matter

Assuming Nvidia’s index weight remains unchanged and other component stocks stay flat, a 10% price move in Nvidia would translate to roughly 0.78 percentage points added or subtracted from the S&P 500’s return; of course, the actual index movement still depends on overall market performance.

Nvidia is scheduled to hold a conference call at 5 p.m. Eastern Time on November 17 and will release its Q3 earnings for fiscal year 2027 before the call. Market focus will be on whether AI compute demand continues and the growth momentum of data‑center capital expenditures.

Additionally, at the time of this report, the company is shrouded in unique uncertainty. Nvidia’s board stated that after reports indicated CEO Jensen Huang was a target of foreign intelligence operations, the board launched an independent investigation.

However, the board emphasized that there is currently no evidence that national security or Nvidia’s commercial secrets have been compromised; the allegations remain under review and have not been concluded.
What investors should watch for
Malek categorizes investment risk into two types: market risk that affects the overall stock market, and company‑specific risk that can usually be mitigated through diversification.
He worries that when index weights become overly concentrated in a few companies, a single company’s problems can have a larger impact on investors who thought they were well diversified.
During periods of mega‑cap tech rally, market‑cap‑weighted indices do indeed deliver substantial returns, but equal‑weight funds also have their own trade‑offs.
The key is not to ask investors to abandon index funds, but to make sure they understand what assets they actually hold.
As the earnings date approaches, investors may want to re‑examine their 401(k) accounts, S&P 500 index funds, and other tech or growth ETFs to confirm how much capital is actually exposed to Nvidia.
Even without directly buying Nvidia stock, investors’ retirement savings may still fluctuate with the performance of this earnings report.

items.title: 私生活風暴燒向國安議題！美眾院外交、情報委員會出手 準備傳喚黃仁勳
items.title_en: Personal Scandal Fuels National Security Debate: House Foreign Affairs and Intelligence Committees Prepare to Summon Nvidia CEO
paras: 輝達執行長黃仁勳爆出第二起婚外情事件之際，兩名共和黨重量級眾議員週三(11日)表示，已準備向黃仁勳發出傳票，要求他就與一名女子發生婚外情的醜聞，以及輝達的安全規程出席閉門說明會。
眾議院共和黨人John Moolenaar表示，黃仁勳必須在週三結束前回應此前的出席要求。若他不同意出席，也不提出其他日期，很可能會收到傳票。外交委員會主席Brian Mast隨後也在國會大廈對記者證實，委員會正準備發出傳票。
Moolenaar、Mast與情報委員會主席Rick Crawford上週已聯名要求黃仁勳就晶片製造商的安全規程作證，隨著他與黃樂(Alice Huang)婚外情消息曝光，這一要求更顯重要。
醜聞嚴重衝擊輝達股價，消息曝光後兩個交易日累計下跌約10%，同期在標普500指數成分股中表現倒數第二，即便週三大盤普漲，輝達在盤後股價仍暴跌近10%。
此外，爆料也加速國會將一系列晶片出口管制措施納入年底必須通過的《國防授權法》。Mast對納入管制措施表示樂觀，稱「我們現在正處於我們希望的位置」。
Moolenaar直言，在AI晶片出口管制爭論中，輝達已「失去很多公信力」，各方日益形成共識需在法案中納入相關條款。
paras_en: When Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was exposed for a second extramarital affair, two heavyweight Republican House members on Wednesday (11th) announced they were ready to issue a subpoena to Huang, demanding he testify before a closed-door briefing on the affair with a woman and Nvidia’s security protocols.

House Republican John Moolenaar said Huang must respond to the prior attendance request by the end of Wednesday. If he refuses to attend and offers no alternative date, he is likely to receive a subpoena. Foreign Affairs Committee Chair Brian Mast later confirmed to reporters in the Capitol that the committee is preparing to issue a subpoena.

Last week, Moolenaar, Mast and Intelligence Committee Chair Rick Crawford jointly demanded that Huang testify on the chipmaker’s security procedures, a request that became even more pressing with the revelation of his affair with Alice Huang.

The scandal severely impacted Nvidia’s stock, with a cumulative drop of about 10% over two trading days after the news. During the same period, Nvidia ranked second-to-last among S&P 500 constituents, and even though the market rose on Wednesday, Nvidia’s after‑hours price fell nearly 10%.

The leak also accelerated Congress’s effort to include a series of chip export controls in the Defense Authorization Act that must pass by year‑end. Mast expressed optimism about the inclusion, saying, "We are now in the position we want."

Moolenaar bluntly stated that in the AI chip export control debate, Nvidia has "lost a lot of credibility," and that there is a growing consensus that related provisions must be incorporated into the bill.

items.title: WSJ：黃仁勳婚外情風波不斷 衝擊在台形象
items.title_en: WSJ: Jensen Huang's Affair Scandal Continues, Shaking His Image in Taiwan
paras: 《華爾街日報》報導，輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 坦承婚外情後，與他交往的中國企業高階主管黃樂 (Alice Huang) 又被指是中國間諜，使這場風波在台灣從名人私生活延燒至國安議題。內政部長劉世芳週三 (11 日) 表示，黃樂將被禁止再次入境台灣，國安機關仍在調查。台北市長蔣萬安則表示，市府與輝達溝通順暢，台灣總部案將按原計畫推進。
從夜市追星到國安疑慮
黃仁勳在台灣出生、曾在台南生活，後隨家人移居泰國，再赴美發展。近年他每逢台北國際電腦展 (COMPUTEX) 返台，從棒球場開球到逛夜市、到餐廳用餐，所到之處常有媒體與粉絲守候，搶拍合照、索取簽名。
外媒甚至以「Jensanity」(仁來瘋) 形容這股追星熱潮。
《華爾街日報》報導，黃仁勳也曾被拍到與黃樂在台北餐廳同桌用餐。
台灣大學政治系教授 Lev Nachman 表示，許多台灣民眾得知消息後感到震驚、難以置信。黃仁勳過去給人的印象像是個親切又有魅力的叔叔，這也讓風波與他原有的公眾形象形成強烈落差。
作家 Min Chao 則指出，婚外情傳聞剛出現時，不少台灣民眾抱持懷疑態度。即使黃仁勳坦承婚外情，本地媒體起初也多從名人私生活角度處理。
東吳大學政治系副教授陳方隅分析，社會對富有男性的婚外情往往較為寬容，但事件一旦涉及中國情報活動的疑雲，許多台灣民眾就會從國安角度看待。台灣近年持續查辦涉及中國的間諜案件，先進晶片產業又是「矽盾」論述的核心，因此相關疑慮在台灣格外敏感。
輝達與台灣供應鏈緊密相連
黃仁勳在台灣的聲望，也與輝達帶動的產業成長有關。
台積電 (2330-TW) 為輝達代工最先進的 AI 晶片，輝達也有多家客戶設在台灣。黃仁勳今年稍早曾表示，輝達每年在台支出將達 1,500 億美元，輝達也宣布將在台北設立台灣總部。
AI 需求推動台灣經濟成長，台積電市值占台灣證券交易所上市公司總市值逾三分之一，也讓許多投資人透過股市參與這波行情。
不過，科技業以外能否分享成長紅利，一直是台灣社會的討論焦點。近期 AI 股回檔，投資人也感受到科技股波動對台股的影響。
蔣萬安稱台灣總部案照計畫進行
風波延燒之際，台北市與輝達的合作也受到關注。
尋求連任的蔣萬安將爭取輝達台灣總部落腳台北列為任內政績之一，適逢 11 月底地方選舉，總部案進度也成為地方政治焦點。蔣萬安在週二 (10 日) 播出的台視專訪中表示，市府與輝達的溝通維持順暢，雙方將依原定計畫推進總部案。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair, and the Chinese corporate executive he was involved with, Alice Huang, was accused of being a Chinese spy, turning the scandal in Taiwan from a celebrity's private life into a national security issue. Taiwan's Minister of the Interior Liu Shih-fang on Wednesday (Nov. 11) announced that Alice Huang would be barred from re-entering Taiwan, and national security agencies are still investigating. Taipei Mayor Jiang Wan-an said the city government has been in smooth communication with NVIDIA, and the Taiwan headquarters project will proceed as planned.
From Night Markets to National Security Concerns

Jensen Huang was born in Taiwan, lived in Tainan, then moved with his family to Thailand before heading to the United States. In recent years, whenever he returns to Taiwan for the Taipei International Computer Show (COMPUTEX), he goes from opening the baseball stadium to strolling through night markets and dining at restaurants, and media and fans often wait for him, snapping photos and requesting autographs.
Foreign media even dubbed the fan frenzy "Jensanity" (Jensen Madness).
The Wall Street Journal reported that Jensen Huang was also photographed dining with Alice Huang at a Taipei restaurant.

Professor Lev Nachman of the University of Taiwan's Department of Political Science said many Taiwanese people were shocked and found it hard to believe. Huang had previously been seen as a friendly and charismatic uncle, which made the scandal starkly contrast with his former public image.

Writer Min Chao noted that when the affair rumors first emerged, many Taiwanese people were skeptical. Even though Jensen Huang admitted to the affair, local media initially treated it mainly as a celebrity's private life issue.

Associate Professor Chen Fang-yu of Soochow University's Department of Political Science analyzed that society is often more tolerant of wealthy men's affairs, but when the incident involves alleged Chinese intelligence activity, many Taiwanese view it from a national security perspective. Taiwan has been actively investigating Chinese spy cases in recent years, and the advanced chip industry is at the heart of the "silicon dilemma" debate, making related concerns particularly sensitive in Taiwan.
NVIDIA's Tightly Linked Supply Chain in Taiwan
Huang's reputation in Taiwan is also tied to the industry growth driven by NVIDIA.

TSMC (2330-TW) is the first to manufacture NVIDIA's most advanced AI chips, and NVIDIA also has several customers based in Taiwan. Earlier this year, Huang said NVIDIA's annual spending in Taiwan would reach 150 billion dollars, and NVIDIA announced it would establish a Taiwan headquarters in Taipei.

AI demand is driving Taiwan's economic growth, and TSMC's market value accounts for more than a third of the total market value of companies listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange, allowing many investors to participate in this wave through the stock market.

However, whether the growth benefits can be shared beyond the tech sector has long been a focal point of Taiwanese society. Recently, AI stocks have pulled back, and investors have felt the impact of tech stock volatility on the Taiwan market.
Jiang Wan-an Says Taiwan Headquarters Project Will Proceed as Planned
During the scandal, the cooperation between Taipei City and NVIDIA also attracted attention.

Seeking re-election, Jiang Wan-an aims to secure NVIDIA's Taiwan headquarters in Taipei as one of his achievements, coinciding with the local elections at the end of November, and the progress of the headquarters project has become a focal point of local politics. In a TV interview on Tuesday (Nov. 10), Jiang Wan-an said the city government and NVIDIA have maintained smooth communication, and both parties will proceed with the headquarters project as originally planned.

items.title: 接班風險遽升！華爾街示警：黃仁勳若被迫離職 輝達股價恐暴跌至少20%
items.title_en: Succession Risk Soars! Wall Street Warns Nvidia Stock Could Plunge at Least 20% If Jensen Huang Is Forced Out
paras: AI晶片巨擘輝達創辦人暨執行長黃仁勳因一連串個人醜聞身陷風暴，美媒報導稱該公司董事會正考慮將其罷免，市場擔憂輝達恐面臨領導層真空，華爾街分析師更警告若黃仁勳突然離職，輝達股價可能重挫20%甚至更多。
事件源於黃仁勳被曝婚外情，《紐約時報》周三(11日)更報導稱其與一名直接向其匯報的高管存在特殊關係，《華爾街日報》隨後披露輝達董事會正準備罷免黃仁勳，並考慮任命財務長克雷斯為臨時執行長，同時對外尋找新任人選。受此影響，連日下跌的輝達在周三盤後交易一度再跌近10%。
華爾街對輝達的熱情迅速降溫。美國投行Baird將其評等從「買進」下調至「中立」，目標價從500美元狂砍至200美元，降幅超過60%，摩根士丹利也將其從「首選股」名單中移除。
此外，瑞穗證券、花旗與富國銀行相繼下調目標價，其中瑞穗降至250美元，但部分機構仍維持「買進」評級，視當前股價為買入機會。
接受《CNBC》訪問的分析師普遍憂心領導層變天帶來的衝擊。Deepwater資產管理合夥人Gene Munster指出，對一家由創辦人主導且無明確二號人物的公司，離職傳聞是股價回調20%的前兆。
海港研究夥伴分析師Jay Goldberg也預期至少跌20%，並稱考慮到黃仁勳在公司管理體系的核心地位，實際跌幅可能更大。黃仁勳是輝達成立以來唯一一任執行長，目前有70名員工直接向其匯報，這種高度集權架構放大接班不確定性，市場擔憂的不僅是誰來接任，還包括決策機制能否平穩過渡。
不過，一些分析師認為長期影響可控。StoneX分析師Cody Acree與D.A. Davidson分析師Gil Luria強調，只要接班安排妥當，輝達長期經營未必受實質影響，因黃仁勳已奠定穩固的業務基礎與產業合作關係，未來兩年業務未必發生實質變化。
Wedbush分析師Matt Bryson則比較輝達與台積電的估值，認為兩者差距很大程度反映出市場對黃仁勳去留的擔憂。
對輝達而言，當前最大考驗是如何在應對醜聞與董事會決策的同時，向市場證明公司運作不依賴單一人。即將公布的業績以及管理層對公司治理的回應，將成為投資人判斷局勢走向的重要依據。
paras_en: Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the giant of AI chips, has been caught in a storm of personal scandals. U.S. media reports say the board is considering removing him, and the market fears a leadership vacuum at Nvidia. Wall Street analysts warn that if Huang were to leave suddenly, Nvidia’s share price could tumble 20% or more.

The trouble began when Huang was exposed for an extramarital affair. The New York Times reported on Wednesday the 11th that he has a special relationship with a senior executive who reports directly to him. The Wall Street Journal later disclosed that Nvidia’s board is preparing to oust Huang and is considering appointing CFO Chris (Cris) as interim CEO while searching externally for a permanent replacement. The news sent Nvidia, already sliding, down nearly another 10% in after‑hours trading on Wednesday.

Wall Street’s enthusiasm for Nvidia cooled quickly. U.S. investment bank Baird cut its rating from “Buy” to “Neutral” and slashed the target price from $500 to $200, a drop of more than 60%. Morgan Stanley also removed Nvidia from its “Top Picks” list.

In addition, Mizuho Securities, Citi and Wells Fargo all lowered their target prices, with Mizuho cutting its target to $250, though some firms kept a “Buy” rating, viewing the current price as a buying opportunity.

Analysts interviewed by CNBC expressed broad concern about the impact of a leadership shake‑up. Gene Munster, a partner at Deepwater Asset Management, said that for a founder‑led company with no clear second‑in‑command, rumors of a departure are a precursor to a 20% stock correction.

Jay Goldberg of Harbour Research Partners also expects at least a 20% drop, noting that given Huang’s central role in Nvidia’s management structure the actual decline could be larger. Huang has been the sole CEO since Nvidia’s founding and 70 employees report directly to him; this highly centralized structure magnifies succession uncertainty, and the market worries not only about who will replace him but also whether decision‑making can transition smoothly.

However, some analysts see the long‑term impact as manageable. StoneX analyst Cody Acree and D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria stressed that if the succession plan is handled properly, Nvidia’s long‑term operations may not be materially affected, as Huang has already built a solid business foundation and industry partnerships, and the business may not change substantially over the next two years.
Wedbush analyst Matt Bryson compared Nvidia’s valuation with TSMC’s, arguing that the large gap largely reflects market anxiety over Huang’s future at the company.

For Nvidia, the biggest test now is to navigate the scandal and board decisions while proving to the market that the company does not depend on a single individual. Upcoming earnings and management’s response to corporate‑governance issues will be key cues for investors assessing the direction of the situation.

items.title: 才說要停產、5天後又改口 馬斯克宣布Cybertruck延後退場
items.title_en: Elon Musk Announces Cybertruck Production Delay to Summer 2027
paras: 曾被特斯拉(TSLA-US)  執行長馬斯譽為「史上最好產品」的電動皮卡Cybertruck，停產時間再生變數。馬斯克週三（11 日）宣布，將延長生產至2027年夏末，以消化大量積壓訂單。
馬斯克上週五才表示，特斯拉計劃在2027年年中左右停止生產Cybertruck，將更多產能轉向無方向盤的自動駕駛計程車Cybercab。如今雖然停產時間略為延後，但Cybertruck即將退出市場的方向並未改變。
這項決定也意味著，曾被寄予厚望、肩負特斯拉進軍高利潤皮卡市場重任的Cybertruck，最終仍將面臨停產命運。
針對外界質疑Cybertruck無法獲利，馬斯克澄清，相關報導並不屬實，強調Cybertruck目前仍能實現獲利。
不過，他也坦言，Cybertruck的製造過程過於「複雜」，因此特斯拉不得不決定停產。
馬斯克同時透露，Cybertruck的訂單成長速度遠遠超過生產速度。按照原先規劃，特斯拉將在大約八個月後關閉生產線，屆時可能必須向大量客戶退還訂金。
如今馬斯克宣布延長生產至2027年夏末，主要就是為了進一步消化尚未交付的訂單。
Cybertruck於2019年底首次以概念車亮相，憑藉突破傳統的外觀設計迅速引發市場關注，評價也呈現兩極化。
相較於其他汽車製造商偏向保守、逐步改良的皮卡設計，Cybertruck採用稜角分明的車身線條與不鏽鋼材質，徹底打破傳統皮卡的外觀框架。
其設計據稱受到電影《回到未來》（Back to the Future）中經典車款DeLorean DMC-12啟發，特斯拉的宣傳影像更刻意營造出Cybertruck彷彿能在其他星球行駛的未來感，呼應馬斯克的太空探索野心。
Cybertruck亮相後一度掀起預訂熱潮。特斯拉表示，自2019年發表以來，累計收到超過100萬份預訂，每份訂金為100美元。
馬斯克當時更預估，Cybertruck每年銷量可達15萬至25萬輛，展現對這款電動皮卡的高度期待。
然而，Cybertruck最終未能實現當初設定的銷售目標。
根據汽車市場研究機構Cox Automotive統計，過去三年特斯拉僅售出約7.6萬輛Cybertruck，與馬斯克原先預估的年銷量相去甚遠。
值得注意的是，這項銷售數據還包括2025年特斯拉向馬斯克旗下另一家公司SpaceX出售、總價值達1.31億美元的Cybertruck。
Cybertruck的銷售困境也反映出美國電動皮卡市場面臨的挑戰。儘管這款車曾憑藉前衛設計與技術受到高度矚目，實際市場需求卻未能達到預期。
隨著特斯拉逐步將產能轉向Cybercab，Cybertruck這款曾被馬斯克稱為公司「有史以來最好產品」的電動皮卡，也將在2027年夏末迎來生產終點。
paras_en: The electric pickup truck Cybertruck, once hailed by Tesla CEO Elon Musk as the "best product in history," has its production halt date once again becoming uncertain. Musk announced on Wednesday (November 11) that production will be extended until the end of summer 2027 to absorb a large backlog of orders.

Last Friday, Musk had said Tesla plans to stop producing the Cybertruck around mid-2027, shifting more capacity to the steering‑less autonomous ride‑share vehicle Cybercab. Although the end date has been pushed back slightly, the direction of the Cybertruck’s exit from the market remains unchanged.
This decision also means that the Cybertruck, which had been expected to carry Tesla into the high‑margin pickup market, will ultimately face a production shutdown.
In response to external doubts that the Cybertruck could not be profitable, Musk clarified that such reports were untrue, emphasizing that the Cybertruck is still capable of generating profit.
However, he also admitted that the manufacturing process for the Cybertruck is too "complex," which is why Tesla had to decide to discontinue it.

Musk also revealed that the growth rate of Cybertruck orders far outpaces production speed. According to the original plan, Tesla would shut down the production line in about eight months, at which point it might have to refund deposits to a large number of customers.
Now that Musk has announced an extension of production until the end of summer 2027, the main reason is to further absorb the orders that have not yet been delivered.
The Cybertruck first appeared as a concept car at the end of 2019, quickly attracting market attention with its unconventional design, and its reception has been polarized.

Unlike other automakers that favor conservative, incremental pickup designs, the Cybertruck uses sharp, angular body lines and stainless steel, completely breaking the traditional pickup aesthetic framework.

Its design is said to be inspired by the classic DeLorean DMC‑12 from the film "Back to the Future," and Tesla’s promotional imagery deliberately creates a sense that the Cybertruck could drive on other planets, echoing Musk’s space‑exploration ambitions.
After its debut, the Cybertruck sparked a surge in pre‑orders. Tesla stated that since its 2019 launch, it has received over one million pre‑orders, each with a $100 deposit.
At the time, Musk estimated that the Cybertruck could sell 150,000 to 250,000 units per year, showing high expectations for the electric pickup.
However, the Cybertruck ultimately failed to meet the initially set sales targets.
According to automotive market research firm Cox Automotive, Tesla sold only about 76,000 Cybertrucks in the past three years, far below Musk’s original annual sales estimate.
Notably, this sales figure also includes the Cybertrucks sold in 2025 to Musk’s other company SpaceX for a total value of $131 million.

The Cybertruck’s sales difficulties also reflect the challenges facing the U.S. electric pickup market. Despite the vehicle’s avant‑garde design and technology drawing high attention, actual market demand fell short of expectations.
As Tesla gradually shifts capacity to the Cybercab, the Cybertruck—once called by Musk the company’s "best product ever"—will reach the end of its production run by the end of summer 2027.

items.title: 黃仁勳再爆與副總裁有染！隨扈扣留目擊者 要求簽保密協議
items.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Accused of Affair with Vice President, Security Detail Detains Witnesses, Demands NDA
paras: 在人工智慧晶片大廠輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳外遇而受到全球圍觀之際，《紐約時報》周三（11日）踢爆黃仁勳還曾與一名向他直接報告的高階主管發生婚外情。
《紐約時報》引述多名曾在輝達任職、但未具名人士報導，黃仁勳曾與輝達醫療事業副總裁Kimberly Powell發展關係。今年3月，在輝達一場大型會議期間，黃仁勳被拍到與Powell在加州聖荷西一家飯店內親密互動的畫面。
事發後，黃仁勳的隨扈扣留了目擊者，並要求對方簽署保密協議。
《紐約時報》指出，記者周三致電黃仁勳詢問他與Powell女士的關係時，黃仁勳表示，「我認為你不應該直接和我談這件事。」隨後便掛斷電話。
消息人士透露，黃仁勳和Powell的關係已在輝達內部受到議論。
輝達現行《商業行為準則》規定，員工必須避免使自身行為造成利益衝突，其中特別提及了「個人關係」，並承諾將對任何不當行為指控迅速展開調查。
在現代企業治理體系中，管理層與直屬下屬發生戀愛關係通常被視為重大合規漏洞，極易引發利益衝突與濫用職權的道德風險。
Powell於2008年加入輝達，負責將輝達晶片技術應用於高等教育和醫療保健領域的項目，尤其是在醫學影像設備方面。
她在輝達一路晉升，她的LinkedIn個人資料顯示，她於2016年晉升為人工智慧業務開發資深總監2017年底被任命為醫療保健副總裁，經常出席世界各地技術會議，代表輝達發表演說。
paras_en: While Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang is under global scrutiny for an alleged affair, the New York Times on Wednesday (11th) revealed that he also had an extramarital relationship with a senior executive who reported directly to him.

The Times cited unnamed former Nvidia employees, stating that Huang had a relationship with Nvidia Medical Business Vice President Kimberly Powell. In March, during a large Nvidia conference, Huang was photographed engaging in intimate interactions with Powell at a hotel in San Jose, California.
After the incident, Huang’s security detail detained the witness and demanded that the individual sign a confidentiality agreement.
When a reporter called Huang on Wednesday to inquire about his relationship with Ms. Powell, Huang replied, “I don’t think you should talk to me directly about this,” and then hung up the phone.
Sources say that the relationship between Huang and Powell has already become a topic of discussion within Nvidia’s internal circles.

Nvidia’s current Code of Business Conduct requires employees to avoid actions that create conflicts of interest, specifically mentioning “personal relationships,” and promises to launch a swift investigation into any allegations of misconduct.

In modern corporate governance, romantic relationships between management and direct subordinates are typically viewed as major compliance breaches, easily leading to conflicts of interest and ethical risks of abuse of power.
Powell joined Nvidia in 2008, responsible for applying Nvidia chip technology to higher education and healthcare projects, especially in medical imaging equipment.

Her LinkedIn profile shows a steady rise at Nvidia: promoted to Senior Director of AI Business Development in 2016, appointed Vice President of Healthcare at the end of 2017, and frequently attending global tech conferences to speak on behalf of Nvidia.

items.title: Anthropic上市前永續合約單日漲8% 交易者估值推升至1.84兆美元
items.title_en: Anthropic's Pre-IPO Futures Contract Rises 8% in a Day, Boosting Trader Valuation to $1.84 Trillion
paras: Anthropic上市前永續合約周三(11日)上漲8%，反映交易者對這家Claude模型開發商上市的需求升溫，加上AI類股反彈，帶動市場隱含估值升至約1.84兆美元。
該合約在Polymarket以ANT為代號，追蹤Anthropic的完全稀釋估值；周三下午報1,836.10點，24小時漲8%，盤中介於1,685.40至1,868.10點。其參考價格來自Hyperliquid上的Entropy io:ANTH市場，每點代表10億美元完全稀釋估值。該市場未平倉部位約2億美元。
另一個由trade.xyz提供、以每股價格計算的合約約報105美元，較Anthropic首次公開發行(IPO)價格區間上限高約34%。永續合約反映交易者預期，並不代表Anthropic實際股權估值或上市價格。
Anthropic周二啟動上市路演，提出每股70至78美元的價格區間，計畫發行8.25億股；若以區間上限計算，募資約644億美元，完全稀釋估值約1.4兆美元。永續合約隱含估值比此上限高約31%。
彭博周三引述知情人士報導，IPO認購需求已達發售股數的數倍；《金融時報》則報導，承銷銀行正考慮將估值提高至1.5兆美元或以上。此前9月流出的早期上市文件草案，據報曾以約2兆美元估值為目標；近期AI類股大幅回檔後，Anthropic提出較低價格區間。
AI類股周三同步反彈。CoreWeave(CRWV-US)公布第三季財報後大漲約27%，輝達(NVDA-US)上漲5%，追蹤那斯達克100指數的Invesco QQQ信託(QQQ-US)上漲3.1%；Anthropic推出新辦公室工具後，微軟(MSFT-US)下跌2.1%。
Anthropic周二在舊金山活動中推出Claude Sheets試算表工具，以及Claude Meetings與Claude Whiteboards，擴大Claude在辦公室生產力軟體市場的應用。
分析師普遍肯定Anthropic採取較低的IPO價格區間。Wedbush分析師丹・艾夫斯周二在投資人報告中表示，這種規模的上市只有一次亮相機會，讓價格更容易被市場消化，比再多追求一輪估值更重要。
艾夫斯也指出，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、輝達、微軟、博通(AVGO-US)及另外三家夥伴提供的260億美元私募資金，可能比IPO headline估值更具意義。Trade Nation資深市場分析師大衛・莫里森也認為，面對科技股市場不確定性，Anthropic願意接受較低價格而非延後上市，是正面訊號。
Morningstar分析師馬利克・艾哈邁德・汗估算，Anthropic基本情境股權價值約1.7兆美元，樂觀情境略高於3兆美元，悲觀情境則為5,000億美元；他預期公司未來五年營收年均成長47%。他指出，財富500強企業每支出1,000美元，目前僅約1美元流向Anthropic。
不過，也有分析師質疑公司成本結構。22V Research創辦人丹尼斯・德布斯謝表示，Anthropic的S-1文件顯示，研發支出遠高於提供客戶服務的成本，而競爭對手可能決定市場價格。他警告，若情況如此，Anthropic可能逐漸成為差異化不足的「商品化智慧服務商」。他認為，投資人需要觀察公司上市後數季的正式數據，才能判斷長期合理利潤率。
Polymarket預測市場交易者給予Anthropic在11月19日開始交易的機率為86%，並認為股價首日收盤高於IPO發行價的機率為88%；但市場給予其首日市值高於1.5兆美元的機率只有43%。
paras_en: Anthropic's pre‑IPO perpetual contract rose 8% on Wednesday (the 11th), reflecting traders’ growing demand for the Claude model developer’s listing, and the AI‑stock rebound lifted the market’s implied valuation to about $1.84 trillion.

The contract trades on Polymarket under the ticker ANT and tracks Anthropic’s fully diluted valuation; on Wednesday afternoon it was quoted at 1,836.10 points, up 8% over 24 hours, trading between 1,685.40 and 1,868.10 points during the day. Its reference price comes from the Entropy io:ANTH market on Hyperliquid, where each point represents a $100 million fully diluted valuation. The market has roughly $200 million in open interest.

Another contract, provided by trade.xyz and priced per share, was quoted at about $105, roughly 34% above the upper end of Anthropic’s IPO price range. The perpetual contract reflects traders’ expectations and does not represent Anthropic’s actual equity valuation or listing price.

Anthropic kicked off its roadshow on Tuesday, proposing a $70 to $78 per‑share price range and planning to issue 825 million shares; at the upper end of the range, the proceeds would be about $64.4 billion, implying a fully diluted valuation of roughly $1.4 trillion. The perpetual contract’s implied valuation is about 31% higher than this upper limit.

Bloomberg quoted an insider on Wednesday saying that IPO subscription demand had reached multiple times the number of shares offered; the Financial Times reported that underwriters were considering raising the valuation to $1.5 trillion or more. Earlier September, the early filing draft had targeted a valuation of about $2 trillion; after a sharp pullback in AI stocks, Anthropic proposed a lower price range.

AI stocks rebounded on Wednesday as well. CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) surged about 27% after its Q3 earnings, Nvidia (NVDA‑US) rose 5%, and the Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ‑US), which tracks the Nasdaq‑100, climbed 3.1%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) fell 2.1% after Anthropic launched new office tools.

On Tuesday in San Francisco, Anthropic unveiled Claude Sheets, a spreadsheet tool, as well as Claude Meetings and Claude Whiteboards, expanding Claude’s presence in the office productivity software market.

Analysts broadly praised Anthropic’s decision to set a lower IPO price range. Wedbush analyst Dan Aves said on Tuesday in an investor briefing that a company of this size only has one chance to debut, so a lower price is easier for the market to digest than chasing another valuation round.

Aves also noted that the $26 billion private‑funding round from Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Nvidia, Microsoft, Broadcom (AVGO‑US), and three other partners may be more meaningful than the headline IPO valuation. Trade Nation senior market analyst David Morrison said that, amid uncertainty in the tech‑stock market, Anthropic’s willingness to accept a lower price rather than delay the listing is a positive signal.

Morningstar analyst Malik Ahmad Khan estimated that Anthropic’s base‑case equity value is about $1.7 trillion, a bullish scenario slightly above $3 trillion, and a bearish scenario at $500 billion; he expects the company’s revenue to grow at an annualized 47% over the next five years. He pointed out that for every $1,000 spent by Fortune 500 companies, only about $1 currently goes to Anthropic.

However, some analysts questioned the company’s cost structure. Dennis Debus, founder of 22V Research, said that Anthropic’s S‑1 filings show R&D spending far exceeding customer‑service costs, and competitors may set market prices. He warned that if this is the case, Anthropic could gradually become a commoditized “intelligent‑services” provider lacking differentiation. He believes investors should watch the company’s formal data for several quarters after the listing to judge long‑term profitability.

Polymarket predicts that traders give Anthropic an 86% probability of trading starting on November 19, and an 88% probability that the first‑day close will be above the IPO price; however, the market assigns only a 43% probability that the first‑day market cap will exceed $1.5 trillion.

items.title: 網友拱延攬黃仁勳 馬斯克：那是我的榮幸
items.title_en: Netizens Urge Elon Musk to Recruit Jensen Huang; Musk: "It Would Be My Honor"
paras: 人工智慧晶片大廠輝達（Nvidia）(NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳面臨下台危機，有網友呼籲全球首富馬斯克延攬黃仁勳，馬斯克回應：「那是我的榮幸。」
在黃仁勳桃色風暴爆出之際，馬斯克也曾為黃仁勳辯護，稱黃仁勳在人工智慧領域的地位無可取代。
據《彭博》周四 （12日）報導，輝達正與外部機構合作，物色可能接替執行長黃仁勳的人選，包括考慮任命一位過渡時期執行長。另據《華爾街日報》報導，輝達董事會最快可能周三開會討論黃仁勳去留。
華爾街正密切評估，如果這位人工智慧基礎設施核心架構師被迫離職，將對整個行業的資金鏈、客戶信心與發展前景造成何種程度的衝擊。
雪上加霜的是，《紐約時報》周三引述多名曾在輝達任職、但未具名人士報導，黃仁勳曾與輝達醫療事業副總裁Kimberly Powell發展關係。今年3月，在輝達一場大型會議期間，黃仁勳被拍到與Powell在加州聖荷西一家飯店內親密互動的畫面。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence chip giant Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang faces a crisis of removal; netizens called on the world’s richest man Elon Musk to recruit Huang, and Musk responded: “It would be my honor.”
Amid the scandal surrounding Huang’s alleged affair, Musk also defended Huang, saying his position in the AI field is irreplaceable.

According to Bloomberg on Thursday (the 12th), Nvidia is working with external firms to identify possible successors to CEO Jensen Huang, including considering appointing an interim CEO. The Wall Street Journal also reported that Nvidia’s board could meet as early as Wednesday to discuss Huang’s future.
Wall Street is closely assessing how the forced departure of this core AI infrastructure architect would impact the industry’s financing chain, customer confidence, and development outlook.

Adding insult to injury, the New York Times on Wednesday quoted multiple unnamed former Nvidia employees who reported that Huang had a relationship with Nvidia’s vice president of medical affairs Kimberly Powell. In March this year, during a large Nvidia conference, Huang was photographed having an intimate interaction with Powell at a hotel in San Jose, California.

items.title: 沒買輝達也受影響！標普500權重近8% 一份財報牽動全美退休金
items.title_en: Even Without Buying Nvidia, Investors Are Affected! S&P 500 Weight Near 8% and a Single Report Moves All American Pension Funds
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 即將於 11 月 17 日公布財報，將吸引數百萬名投資人關注，即使他們並未直接持有輝達股票。由於輝達在標普 500 指數中的權重接近 8%，其財報表現可能牽動全美退休投資組合，也凸顯許多被動投資人可能未曾察覺的持股集中風險。
Siebert Financial 投資長馬萊克 (Mark Malek) 表示：「輝達公布財報的日子，就是你的 401(k) 退休金帳戶公布成績的日子。」
輝達的影響力早已超越直接持有該公司股票的股東。即使投資人只是透過追蹤標普 500 指數的退休基金進行投資，也可能受到輝達個別事件的影響。
標普 500 指數採市值加權編製，市值愈大的企業，所占權重就愈高，因此股價波動對指數表現的影響也愈大。
根據道富環球投資管理 (State Street) 資料，截至 10 月 28 日，輝達占 SPDR 標普 500 ETF (SPY-US) 投資組合的 7.81%，高於蘋果 (AAPL-US) 的 7.52% 及微軟 (MSFT-US) 的 5.91%。前十大持股合計占基金資產約 38%。
即使投資人同時持有多檔 ETF，也不代表能有效分散集中風險，因為追蹤美國大型股的基金，往往持有許多相同的超大型企業。
11 月 17 日財報為何如此重要
假設輝達的指數權重維持不變且其他成分股價格持平，輝達股價每波動 10%，就會為標普 500 指數的報酬率帶來約 0.78 個百分點的增減；當然，指數的實際漲跌幅仍需視整體市場表現而定。
輝達預定於美東時間 11 月 17 日下午 5 點舉行法說會，並於會前公布 2027 會計年度第三季財報，屆時市場焦點將鎖定在 AI 運算需求是否延續，以及資料中心資本支出的成長動能。
此外，這份財報發布之際，公司內部正籠罩著特有的不確定性。輝達董事表示，在有報導指出執行長黃仁勳成為外國情報行動鎖定的目標後，董事會已啟動獨立調查。
不過董事會強調，目前並無跡象顯示國家安全或輝達的商業機密遭到外洩，相關指控仍在審查階段，尚未成為定論。
投資人該注意什麼
馬萊克將投資風險區分為兩類，一類是影響整體股市的市場風險，另一類則是個別公司的特定風險，後者通常可以透過分散持股來降低。
他擔憂的是，當指數權重過度集中在少數企業時，單一公司的問題就可能對原本以為已充分分散風險的投資人造成更大衝擊。
在超大型科技股領漲期間，市值加權指數確實為投資人帶來可觀報酬，但採取等權重配置的基金也有各自的取捨。
重點並不是要求投資人放棄指數基金，而是必須清楚了解自己實際持有哪些資產。
隨著財報日逼近，投資人或許應重新檢視自己的 401(k) 退休金帳戶、標普 500 指數基金，以及其他科技或成長型 ETF，確認其中有多少資金實際曝險於輝達。
即使沒有直接買進輝達股票，投資人的退休儲蓄仍可能隨著這份財報的表現而波動。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) is set to release its earnings on November 17, drawing the attention of millions of investors, even those who do not directly own Nvidia shares. With Nvidia’s weight in the S&P 500 close to 8%, its earnings performance could sway the entire U.S. retirement portfolio and highlight the concentration risk that many passive investors may not have realized.
Mark Malek, CIO of Siebert Financial, said: “The day Nvidia releases its earnings is the day your 401(k) retirement account reports its performance.”
Nvidia’s influence extends beyond shareholders who own the stock directly. Even investors who invest through retirement funds tracking the S&P 500 may be affected by Nvidia’s individual events.
The S&P 500 is a market‑capitalization‑weighted index, so the larger a company’s market value, the higher its weight, and price swings have a greater impact on the index’s performance.

According to State Street Global Investors, as of October 28, Nvidia accounted for 7.81% of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY-US) portfolio, higher than Apple (AAPL-US) at 7.52% and Microsoft (MSFT-US) at 5.91%. The top ten holdings together represent about 38% of the fund’s assets.
Even if investors hold multiple ETFs, it does not guarantee effective diversification of concentration risk, because funds tracking large U.S. stocks often hold many of the same mega‑cap companies.
Why the November 17 earnings matter

Assuming Nvidia’s index weight remains unchanged and other component stocks stay flat, a 10% price move in Nvidia would translate to roughly 0.78 percentage points added or subtracted from the S&P 500’s return; of course, the actual index movement still depends on overall market performance.

Nvidia is scheduled to hold a conference call at 5 p.m. Eastern Time on November 17 and will release its Q3 earnings for fiscal year 2027 before the call. Market focus will be on whether AI compute demand continues and the growth momentum of data‑center capital expenditures.

Additionally, at the time of this report, the company is shrouded in unique uncertainty. Nvidia’s board stated that after reports indicated CEO Jensen Huang was a target of foreign intelligence operations, the board launched an independent investigation.

However, the board emphasized that there is currently no evidence that national security or Nvidia’s commercial secrets have been compromised; the allegations remain under review and have not been concluded.
What investors should watch for
Malek categorizes investment risk into two types: market risk that affects the overall stock market, and company‑specific risk that can usually be mitigated through diversification.
He worries that when index weights become overly concentrated in a few companies, a single company’s problems can have a larger impact on investors who thought they were well diversified.
During periods of mega‑cap tech rally, market‑cap‑weighted indices do indeed deliver substantial returns, but equal‑weight funds also have their own trade‑offs.
The key is not to ask investors to abandon index funds, but to make sure they understand what assets they actually hold.
As the earnings date approaches, investors may want to re‑examine their 401(k) accounts, S&P 500 index funds, and other tech or growth ETFs to confirm how much capital is actually exposed to Nvidia.
Even without directly buying Nvidia stock, investors’ retirement savings may still fluctuate with the performance of this earnings report.

items.title: 私生活風暴燒向國安議題！美眾院外交、情報委員會出手 準備傳喚黃仁勳
items.title_en: Personal Scandal Fuels National Security Debate: House Foreign Affairs and Intelligence Committees Prepare to Summon Nvidia CEO
paras: 輝達執行長黃仁勳爆出第二起婚外情事件之際，兩名共和黨重量級眾議員週三(11日)表示，已準備向黃仁勳發出傳票，要求他就與一名女子發生婚外情的醜聞，以及輝達的安全規程出席閉門說明會。
眾議院共和黨人John Moolenaar表示，黃仁勳必須在週三結束前回應此前的出席要求。若他不同意出席，也不提出其他日期，很可能會收到傳票。外交委員會主席Brian Mast隨後也在國會大廈對記者證實，委員會正準備發出傳票。
Moolenaar、Mast與情報委員會主席Rick Crawford上週已聯名要求黃仁勳就晶片製造商的安全規程作證，隨著他與黃樂(Alice Huang)婚外情消息曝光，這一要求更顯重要。
醜聞嚴重衝擊輝達股價，消息曝光後兩個交易日累計下跌約10%，同期在標普500指數成分股中表現倒數第二，即便週三大盤普漲，輝達在盤後股價仍暴跌近10%。
此外，爆料也加速國會將一系列晶片出口管制措施納入年底必須通過的《國防授權法》。Mast對納入管制措施表示樂觀，稱「我們現在正處於我們希望的位置」。
Moolenaar直言，在AI晶片出口管制爭論中，輝達已「失去很多公信力」，各方日益形成共識需在法案中納入相關條款。
paras_en: When Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was exposed for a second extramarital affair, two heavyweight Republican House members on Wednesday (11th) announced they were ready to issue a subpoena to Huang, demanding he testify before a closed-door briefing on the affair with a woman and Nvidia’s security protocols.

House Republican John Moolenaar said Huang must respond to the prior attendance request by the end of Wednesday. If he refuses to attend and offers no alternative date, he is likely to receive a subpoena. Foreign Affairs Committee Chair Brian Mast later confirmed to reporters in the Capitol that the committee is preparing to issue a subpoena.

Last week, Moolenaar, Mast and Intelligence Committee Chair Rick Crawford jointly demanded that Huang testify on the chipmaker’s security procedures, a request that became even more pressing with the revelation of his affair with Alice Huang.

The scandal severely impacted Nvidia’s stock, with a cumulative drop of about 10% over two trading days after the news. During the same period, Nvidia ranked second-to-last among S&P 500 constituents, and even though the market rose on Wednesday, Nvidia’s after‑hours price fell nearly 10%.

The leak also accelerated Congress’s effort to include a series of chip export controls in the Defense Authorization Act that must pass by year‑end. Mast expressed optimism about the inclusion, saying, "We are now in the position we want."

Moolenaar bluntly stated that in the AI chip export control debate, Nvidia has "lost a lot of credibility," and that there is a growing consensus that related provisions must be incorporated into the bill.

items.title: WSJ：黃仁勳婚外情風波不斷 衝擊在台形象
items.title_en: WSJ: Jensen Huang's Affair Scandal Continues, Shaking His Image in Taiwan
paras: 《華爾街日報》報導，輝達 (NVDA-US) 執行長黃仁勳 (Jensen Huang) 坦承婚外情後，與他交往的中國企業高階主管黃樂 (Alice Huang) 又被指是中國間諜，使這場風波在台灣從名人私生活延燒至國安議題。內政部長劉世芳週三 (11 日) 表示，黃樂將被禁止再次入境台灣，國安機關仍在調查。台北市長蔣萬安則表示，市府與輝達溝通順暢，台灣總部案將按原計畫推進。
從夜市追星到國安疑慮
黃仁勳在台灣出生、曾在台南生活，後隨家人移居泰國，再赴美發展。近年他每逢台北國際電腦展 (COMPUTEX) 返台，從棒球場開球到逛夜市、到餐廳用餐，所到之處常有媒體與粉絲守候，搶拍合照、索取簽名。
外媒甚至以「Jensanity」(仁來瘋) 形容這股追星熱潮。
《華爾街日報》報導，黃仁勳也曾被拍到與黃樂在台北餐廳同桌用餐。
台灣大學政治系教授 Lev Nachman 表示，許多台灣民眾得知消息後感到震驚、難以置信。黃仁勳過去給人的印象像是個親切又有魅力的叔叔，這也讓風波與他原有的公眾形象形成強烈落差。
作家 Min Chao 則指出，婚外情傳聞剛出現時，不少台灣民眾抱持懷疑態度。即使黃仁勳坦承婚外情，本地媒體起初也多從名人私生活角度處理。
東吳大學政治系副教授陳方隅分析，社會對富有男性的婚外情往往較為寬容，但事件一旦涉及中國情報活動的疑雲，許多台灣民眾就會從國安角度看待。台灣近年持續查辦涉及中國的間諜案件，先進晶片產業又是「矽盾」論述的核心，因此相關疑慮在台灣格外敏感。
輝達與台灣供應鏈緊密相連
黃仁勳在台灣的聲望，也與輝達帶動的產業成長有關。
台積電 (2330-TW) 為輝達代工最先進的 AI 晶片，輝達也有多家客戶設在台灣。黃仁勳今年稍早曾表示，輝達每年在台支出將達 1,500 億美元，輝達也宣布將在台北設立台灣總部。
AI 需求推動台灣經濟成長，台積電市值占台灣證券交易所上市公司總市值逾三分之一，也讓許多投資人透過股市參與這波行情。
不過，科技業以外能否分享成長紅利，一直是台灣社會的討論焦點。近期 AI 股回檔，投資人也感受到科技股波動對台股的影響。
蔣萬安稱台灣總部案照計畫進行
風波延燒之際，台北市與輝達的合作也受到關注。
尋求連任的蔣萬安將爭取輝達台灣總部落腳台北列為任內政績之一，適逢 11 月底地方選舉，總部案進度也成為地方政治焦點。蔣萬安在週二 (10 日) 播出的台視專訪中表示，市府與輝達的溝通維持順暢，雙方將依原定計畫推進總部案。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair, and the Chinese corporate executive he was involved with, Alice Huang, was accused of being a Chinese spy, turning the scandal in Taiwan from a celebrity's private life into a national security issue. Taiwan's Minister of the Interior Liu Shih-fang on Wednesday (Nov. 11) announced that Alice Huang would be barred from re-entering Taiwan, and national security agencies are still investigating. Taipei Mayor Jiang Wan-an said the city government has been in smooth communication with NVIDIA, and the Taiwan headquarters project will proceed as planned.
From Night Markets to National Security Concerns

Jensen Huang was born in Taiwan, lived in Tainan, then moved with his family to Thailand before heading to the United States. In recent years, whenever he returns to Taiwan for the Taipei International Computer Show (COMPUTEX), he goes from opening the baseball stadium to strolling through night markets and dining at restaurants, and media and fans often wait for him, snapping photos and requesting autographs.
Foreign media even dubbed the fan frenzy "Jensanity" (Jensen Madness).
The Wall Street Journal reported that Jensen Huang was also photographed dining with Alice Huang at a Taipei restaurant.

Professor Lev Nachman of the University of Taiwan's Department of Political Science said many Taiwanese people were shocked and found it hard to believe. Huang had previously been seen as a friendly and charismatic uncle, which made the scandal starkly contrast with his former public image.

Writer Min Chao noted that when the affair rumors first emerged, many Taiwanese people were skeptical. Even though Jensen Huang admitted to the affair, local media initially treated it mainly as a celebrity's private life issue.

Associate Professor Chen Fang-yu of Soochow University's Department of Political Science analyzed that society is often more tolerant of wealthy men's affairs, but when the incident involves alleged Chinese intelligence activity, many Taiwanese view it from a national security perspective. Taiwan has been actively investigating Chinese spy cases in recent years, and the advanced chip industry is at the heart of the "silicon dilemma" debate, making related concerns particularly sensitive in Taiwan.
NVIDIA's Tightly Linked Supply Chain in Taiwan
Huang's reputation in Taiwan is also tied to the industry growth driven by NVIDIA.

TSMC (2330-TW) is the first to manufacture NVIDIA's most advanced AI chips, and NVIDIA also has several customers based in Taiwan. Earlier this year, Huang said NVIDIA's annual spending in Taiwan would reach 150 billion dollars, and NVIDIA announced it would establish a Taiwan headquarters in Taipei.

AI demand is driving Taiwan's economic growth, and TSMC's market value accounts for more than a third of the total market value of companies listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange, allowing many investors to participate in this wave through the stock market.

However, whether the growth benefits can be shared beyond the tech sector has long been a focal point of Taiwanese society. Recently, AI stocks have pulled back, and investors have felt the impact of tech stock volatility on the Taiwan market.
Jiang Wan-an Says Taiwan Headquarters Project Will Proceed as Planned
During the scandal, the cooperation between Taipei City and NVIDIA also attracted attention.

Seeking re-election, Jiang Wan-an aims to secure NVIDIA's Taiwan headquarters in Taipei as one of his achievements, coinciding with the local elections at the end of November, and the progress of the headquarters project has become a focal point of local politics. In a TV interview on Tuesday (Nov. 10), Jiang Wan-an said the city government and NVIDIA have maintained smooth communication, and both parties will proceed with the headquarters project as originally planned.

隨著美國通脹數據表現強勁，芝加哥聯邦儲備銀行總裁古爾斯比稱最新通脹報告顯示基本通脹趨勢未見好轉，費城聯邦儲備銀行總裁保爾森也稱通脹壓力依然明顯，凸顯美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)官員們鷹派言論，持續推高FED下個月加息的可能性，且聯邦基金期貨目前顯示，下個月加息25個基點基本已成定局，加息50個基點的概率升至10%，市場更完全消化明年年中前共計三次25個基點的加息預期，為美元走勢提供穩定支持；此外，據路透短觀調查顯示，因半導體需求旺盛支撐情緒普遍樂觀，日本11月製造業景氣判斷指數升至正27，為2021年8月以來最高，同時非製造業景氣判斷指數亦飆升至正35，並創2018年6月以來最高，另外日本首相高市早苗稱預計日本央行(BOJ)實施適當的貨幣政策，以穩定實現2%的通脹目標，強勁經濟前景預期數據仍未能支撐日圓走勢，對於未來美日利差的預期令美元兌日圓穩守158.64低點。
據路透調查的債券策略師預計，未來幾個月美國10年期公債收益率將維持在接近5%的水平，但受訪者普遍認為，其預測面臨的風險偏向收益率將進一步上升，推漲美元兌日圓至159.93高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於160.10-30，支撐於159.30-50。
◆EUR/USD
據澳洲官方公布調查顯示，第三季住房貸款環比下降15.5%，投資性住房貸環比下降32.3%，第三季度房貸數據表現慘淡，同時利率市場幾乎確信，澳洲央行(RBA)在今年五次加息後已結束緊縮週期，並已將明年年底前將降息25個基點的預期計入價格，相較於美國通脹數據高於市場預期，推動美元指數及美國公債收益率走高，衝擊澳幣跌至七個月低點，連帶令歐元兌美元自1.1170高點承壓。
隨後德國聯邦統計局公布10月消費者物價指數(CPI)及消費者物價調和指數(HICP)年率終值降至2.8%，與初值一致，另外德國經濟專家委員會成員加布里埃爾.費爾伯邁爾警告稱，美國中期選舉結果不太可能促使華盛頓軟化貿易保護主義立場，反而可能加劇關稅政策的不確定性，打擊歐元兌美元下滑至1.1082低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1110-30，支撐於1.1045-65。
◆GBP/USD

美國CPI數據高於市場預期以及美國FED官員鷹派的言論影響，令市場已完全消化FED於12月9日加息25個基點的預期，拖累英鎊兌美元自1.3385高點下跌；隨著荷姆茲海峽船隻遇襲削弱伊朗停火希望，令油價自前一個交易日的兩個月低點回升，且英國智庫國家經濟社會研究院(NIESR)預測，受伊朗戰爭引發的工資第二輪效應影響，英國央行(BOE)在2030年前恐無法將通脹率降至目標水平，衝擊英鎊兌美元下跌至1.3263低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3290-1.3310，支撐於1.3220-40。

paras_en: USD/JPY

As U.S. inflation data remains robust, Chicago Fed President Goolsbee noted that the latest inflation report shows no easing in core inflation trends, while Philadelphia Fed President Powell also said inflationary pressures remain evident, underscoring the hawkish tone of Fed officials and continuing to raise the likelihood of a rate hike next month. Federal funds futures now indicate a 25‑basis‑point hike next month is essentially a done deal, with the probability of a 50‑basis‑point hike rising to 10%. The market has fully priced in the three 25‑basis‑point hikes expected by mid‑next year, providing stable support for the dollar. In addition, a Reuters short‑term poll shows that optimism is widespread due to strong semiconductor demand; Japan’s November manufacturing PMI rose to +27, the highest since August 2021, while the non‑manufacturing PMI jumped to +35, the highest since June 2018. Japan’s Prime Minister Suga also said the BOJ will implement appropriate monetary policy to achieve the 2% inflation target. Strong economic outlook data still cannot support the yen, and expectations for future U.S.–Japan interest‑rate differentials keep the dollar/yen steady at the 158.64 low.

Bond strategists in a Reuters poll expect U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields to stay near 5% in the coming months, but respondents generally view the risk of yields rising further, pushing the dollar/yen to a 159.93 high. The dollar/yen resistance today is estimated at 160.10‑30, with support at 159.30‑50.
EUR/USD

According to an Australian official survey, Q3 mortgage applications fell 15.5% month‑on‑month, investment‑property applications fell 32.3% month‑on‑month, and Q3 mortgage data performed poorly. Meanwhile, the interest‑rate market is almost certain that the RBA has ended its tightening cycle after five rate hikes this year and has priced in a 25‑basis‑point cut by year‑end. Compared with U.S. inflation data that exceeded expectations, this has driven the dollar index and U.S. Treasury yields higher, pushing the AUD to a seven‑month low and putting pressure on the euro against the dollar from its 1.1170 high.

Germany’s Federal Statistical Office released October CPI and HICP annual rates, both down to 2.8% year‑on‑year, matching initial readings. German Economic Committee member Gabriel Ferbeyme warned that U.S. midterm election results are unlikely to soften Washington’s trade‑protectionist stance and may instead heighten tariff policy uncertainty, denting the euro against the dollar to a 1.1082 low. Today’s euro/dollar resistance is estimated at 1.1110‑30, with support at 1.1045‑65.
GBP/USD

U.S. CPI data exceeded expectations and hawkish Fed comments have led the market to fully price in a 25‑basis‑point hike on December 9, dragging the pound down from its 1.3385 high. With the Strait of Hormuz incident weakening hopes for an Iranian ceasefire, oil prices have rebounded from a two‑month low the previous day. The UK think‑tank NIESR predicts that the wage‑second‑round effect from the Iran war will prevent the BOE from bringing inflation to target before 2030, pushing the pound to a 1.3263 low. Today’s pound/dollar resistance is estimated at 1.3290‑1.3310, with support at 1.3220‑40.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元攀高、日元逼近160關卡 Fed 12月升息機率升至87%
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周三(11日)攀高，聯準會(Fed)官員接連發表鷹派談話，加上美國通膨數據比預期火熱，正在助長聯準會(Fed)下月升息機率。
追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的ICE美元指數(DXY)上漲0.68%，報102.90，盤中觸及2025年4月以來最高水準。
美元兌日元升值0.69%，報159.84日元，升至逾兩個月來最高水準，並逼近心理關卡160日元。
歐元兌美元貶值0.65%，報1.11美元，延續前一交易日跌勢，並觸及2025年5月以來最低水準。
美國10月消費者物價連續第三個月高於預期，促使交易員進一步提高對Fed 12月升息的押注。根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，市場預期聯準會12月升息1碼(25個基點)的機率，已從一個月前約70%升至87%。
Brown Brothers Harriman全球市場策略主管Elias Haddad表示，升息預期升高有助於支撐美元。
Haddad表示：「美元普遍走強，主要受到Fed利率預期轉趨鷹派支撐。這項轉變由高於預期的10月CPI數據推動，近期Fed官員的談話也進一步放大了這股趨勢。」
包括Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)及達拉斯聯準銀行總裁蘿根(Lorie Logan)在內的官員都表示，對通膨居高不下感到不安，華勒甚至不排除大幅升息2碼(50個基點)的可能性，進一步推升市場升息押注。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.50%，報1.33美元，接近兩周來最低點。美元兌瑞士法郎則上漲0.93%，報0.833瑞郎，盤中一度升至10月中旬以來最高水準。

高盛與德銀調整預測 今年多數主要貨幣走貶

周二的通膨數據公布後，部分券商調整對Fed未來貨幣政策的預測。高盛目前預期，Fed將在12月及明年3月升息，德意志銀行則預期，升息時間點將落在12月、明年1月及3月。
除了澳幣與挪威克朗外，多數已開發市場貨幣兌美元今年來均走貶，原因是利差擴大推升美元。部分分析師也將美元今年走強歸因於美國與以色列對伊朗開戰期間，市場資金流向避險資產。
澳幣兌美元貶值0.23%，報0.685美元，美元兌挪威克朗則上漲0.61%，報9.55挪威克朗。
加密貨幣方面，比特幣上漲0.93%至74,460.41美元，以太幣上漲1.19%，報2,079.31美元。
